name: fontshok-mockup-studio
description: FontShok Mockup Studio – local Windows app that produces website typography mockups through Figma

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/figma-plugin/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/src/renderer/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build:plugin && npm run build:desktop
scripts.dev: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run dev -w @fontshok/desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run dist:win -w @fontshok/desktop
